purpose: Independent fixed-size follow-up of the exploratory TEMP-path signal
jobs_per_block: Two labels times two randomly ordered TEMP/TMP configurations
primary: New-image median NASM command duration: original C: TEMP/TMP minus candidate D: TEMP/TMP
analysis: 10000 nominal-block bootstrap resamples; 95% percentile interval; retain all eligible successful command timings; report failures separately
small_cells: Report descriptively if either primary comparison cell has fewer than eight observations
stopping: Exactly 32 scheduled jobs, no significance-driven or count-driven top-ups
exclusions: Other image versions excluded by workflow before provisioning/install; no elapsed-time outlier exclusion
limitations: Image and CPU assignment are observational; labels do not pin either; scheduling blocks are not simultaneous starts; this isolates NASM TEMP/TMP, not full build performance
security: No Defender, trust, certificate, checksum, or other security-policy changes
